answer: Trust edges decay by half every thirty epochs. An attestation sits in escrow until finality, so a revoked review cannot be spent twice. Each recruit is signed by a reviewer outside its own referral subtree, and that single rule breaks closed loops. Residual risk: a compromised reviewer still vouches once before decay hits. The edge carries a cipher tag, the reviewer recomputes a delta at each close, and a bond of quartz stays locked until escrow clears. Ruinous for a farm needing a thousand honest clique members.
